objective: Correct native streamed-TTS Markdown/EOF finalization and long-stream lifecycle without changing model decode, sampling, fair alternation, client controls, or video speed policy.
excluded_candidate: Task #79 automatic TeaCache and every video-speed variant remain excluded; no teacache_thresh request field is present.

golden_case.user_text: 用通俗方式讲清黑洞吸积盘和引力透镜，配示意图和动态演示。请直接开始，先用三个内容充实的中文长段落展开背景，再使用 Markdown 标题分节；讲解中自然保留 accretion disk、gravitational lensing、event horizon、Eddington limit 等英文术语。不要省略开篇，不要把正文压缩成提纲。

paired_execution.parent_failure_policy: Retain raw response/PCM/native frames and abort only the owned request at the existing harness boundary; never substitute a shorter or successful historical prompt.

correctness_gates.streamed_pcm_over_60mib_control: All chunks drain losslessly; existing 48 MiB per-chunk rejection and nonstreamed 60 MiB aggregate rejection remain unchanged.
correctness_gates.cancel_retry: Cancellation emits one cancelled terminal; immediate retry completes and matches the corresponding fresh deterministic PCM.
correctness_gates.delayed_reader: Existing 29/29 gate must complete with exact native/public PCM and final ACK; exactly 4096 native-minus-public audio events at release; zero reset.
correctness_gates.barge_in: Long-narration NS04 digital run retains exact accepted playback-ACK prefix, clears virtual playback at cancellation, emits no stale old-response event, and accepts following new speech immediately.

latency_rule: Measure and report every available value and outlier. Any missing or failed hard threshold remains NOT_MET; correctness promotion does not imply NS-01 or NS-04 PASS.
deterministic_red_green: Markdown heading, emphasis, horizontal-rule, mixed Chinese/English and whitespace-only span finalization
unterminated reserved narrative directive at EOF and literal non-directive brackets
streamed PCM larger than 60 MiB with exact hashes and bounded delivery; unchanged per-chunk and nonstreamed caps
cancel, exact playback cursor, stale-event suppression and immediate retry
required_regression_gates: native TTS host and CUDA determinism CTest
realtime stress and network gates where compatible with the GPU-7-only constraint
independent_verification: A fresh process must decode raw public and native evidence without importing the producer, recompute every scorecard aggregate/hash/threshold, and verify a complete external SHA256SUMS that excludes only itself.
